content: In the fictional Star Trek universe, Ketracel-White, often referred to simply as White, is an isogenic enzyme utilized by the Dominion to exert control over its genetically engineered Jem'Hadar warriors. These warriors are biologically designed to be entirely dependent on this substance for their survival. The Dominion, as the sole supplier of Ketracel-White, ensures the unwavering loyalty and subjugation of the Jem'Hadar to the Founders, the Dominion's ruling class. Ketracel-White serves as the exclusive source of sustenance for the Jem'Hadar, eliminating their need for sleep, food, or any other nutritional intake. The enzyme fulfills all their physiological requirements. In operational settings, the distribution of Ketracel-White is strictly managed by the Vorta, who act as the Dominion's administrators and supervisors. When the Vorta dispenses the White to the assembled Jem'Hadar soldiers, a ceremonial exchange occurs, reinforcing their loyalty to the Founders. The dialogue typically proceeds as follows: Vorta: First [name of the Jem'Hadar First], can you vouch for the loyalty of your men? Jem'Hadar: We pledge our loyalty to the Founders, from now until death. Vorta: Then receive this reward from the Founders. May it make you strong. There has been one documented case of a Jem'Hadar who was not dependent on Ketracel-White. This individual, Goran'Agar, appeared in the Star Trek: Deep Space Nine episode Hippocratic Oath. The reason for his independence from the enzyme was never definitively determined, though it was hypothesized to be the result of a random genetic mutation. Additionally, it is rumored that Ketracel-White can function as a narcotic for other species. The Son'a, for instance, are known to cultivate supplies of the substance for recreational or illicit purposes.
